From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@aurora-analytics.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-22T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pilot inquiry / throughput baseline

Thanks for the invite, Emma — I’ll run the technical portion on Thursday. Quick answers up front:
- Example footprint: for steady ~800 RPS with ~300-token average, teams we’ve benchmarked typically start with a 6–8 GPU dedicated pool (A100/4:8 equivalent) with autoscale headroom for bursts; exact sizing depends on model family and quantization.
- Latency approach: we recommend a reserved pool with burst buffer (predictable p95) + per-route dynamic caching for repeated prefixes; autoscaling can be used for long tails but adds a cold-start profile.
- Cost: I can give ranges in the demo; rough ballpark now is that committed monthly pools at that scale are often mid-five-figure to low-six-figure USD depending on commit length and model choices.

Agenda proposal (30–45m):
1) Intake walkthrough (5–10m): confirm burst profile + sequence lengths
2) Live show (15–20m): demo Dedicated control plane, autoscale/burst behavior, and latency/cost tradeoffs
3) Next steps (10m): procurement checklist + timeline for pilot

Can you attach a short sample of typical prompts (or paste an anonymized row from the spreadsheet)? That lets me prepare a short live run. I attached a draft agenda that we’ll iterate on.

-ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: dedicated-demo-agenda.md (agenda stub)
